targets.rawSql:
WITH aft AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp                                          AS time,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_aft_thrstr_rpm" AS prop_speed,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque"        AS prop_torque,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_aft_prop_shaft_power_w"  AS shaft_power
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp                                          AS time,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_fwd_thrstr_rpm" AS prop_speed,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque"        AS prop_torque,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_fwd_prop_shaft_power_w"  AS shaft_power
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT * FROM aft
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM fwd

SELECT
  timestamp                                                 AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_aft_thrstr_rpm"
    ELSE "devices__thruster_test.r_prop_spd_fwd_thrstr_rpm"
  END                                                       AS speed
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                      AS time,
  "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque" AS torque
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                                                 AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__thruster_test.r_power_aft_trstr_watt"
    ELSE "devices__thruster_test.r_power_fwd_trstr_watt"
  END                                                       AS "power"
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_emotor_temp" ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_emotor_temp" END AS e_motor_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_igbt_temp"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_igbt_temp"   END AS igbt_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_speed_rpm"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_speed_rpm"   END AS speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_torque_nm"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_torque_nm"   END AS torque,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_current"  ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_current"  END AS "current",
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_voltage"  ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_voltage"  END AS voltage
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp                                            AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_current"
    ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_current"
  END                                                  AS "current"
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                                            AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_voltage"
    ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_voltage"
  END                                                  AS voltage
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp                                                 AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT'
    THEN "devices__thruster_test.r_power_aft_trstr_kw"
    ELSE "devices__thruster_test.r_power_fwd_trstr_kw"
  END                                                       AS "power"
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_emotor_temp" AS e_motor_temp,
  "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_igbt_temp" AS igbt_temp
FROM public.prop_test__data 
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' 
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_emotor_temp" AS e_motor_temp,
  "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_igbt_temp" AS igbt_temp
FROM public.prop_test__data 
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' 
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

SELECT
  timestamp                                                  AS time,
  station_selected__value                                    AS station_selected,
  reg_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                      AS aft_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  reg_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                      AS fwd_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  prop_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                     AS aft_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  prop_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                     AS fwd_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  man_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                      AS aft_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  man_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                      AS fwd_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  ((aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value /327.0 ) -50) * 2 AS aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal,
  ((fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value /327.0 ) -50) * 2 AS fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_pshelm
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp                                                  AS time,
  station_selected__value                                    AS station_selected,
  reg_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                      AS aft_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  reg_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                      AS fwd_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  prop_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                     AS aft_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  prop_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                     AS fwd_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  man_mode_selected_aft_thruster__value                      AS aft_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  man_mode_selected_fwd_thruster__value                      AS fwd_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  ((aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value /327.0 ) -50) * 2 AS aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal,
  ((fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal__value /327.0 ) -50) * 2 AS fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_sbhelm
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    speed_or_torque_setpoint__value as torque_setpoint,
    power__value AS "power",
    temp_igbt__value AS igbt_temp,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    speed_or_torque_setpoint__value as torque_setpoint,
    power__value AS "power",
    temp_igbt__value AS igbt_temp,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft_torque AS (
  SELECT
    shear_beam_calculated__value AS torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    speed_or_torque_setpoint__value as torque_setpoint,
    power__value AS "power",
    temp_igbt__value AS igbt_temp,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    speed__value AS speed,
    torque__value AS torque,
    speed_or_torque_setpoint__value as torque_setpoint,
    power__value AS "power",
    temp_igbt__value AS igbt_temp,
    temp_power_stage__value AS power_stage_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_torque AS (
  SELECT
    shear_beam_calculated__value AS torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  aft1.time,
  'Aradex 1' AS device,
  aft1.speed,
  aft1.torque AS aradex_torque,
  aft_torque.torque AS measured_torque,
  aft1.torque_setpoint,
  aft1.power_stage_temp,
  aft1.igbt_temp,
  aft1."power"
FROM aft1, aft_torque

UNION ALL

SELECT
  aft2.time,
  'Aradex 2' AS device,
  aft2.speed,
  aft2.torque AS aradex_torque,
  aft_torque.torque AS measured_torque,
  aft2.torque_setpoint,
  aft2.power_stage_temp,
  aft2.igbt_temp,
  aft2."power"
FROM aft2, aft_torque

UNION ALL

SELECT
  fwd1.time,
  'Aradex 1' AS device,
  fwd1.speed,
  fwd1.torque AS aradex_torque,
  fwd_torque.torque AS measured_torque,
  fwd1.torque_setpoint,
  fwd1.power_stage_temp,
  fwd1.igbt_temp,
  fwd1."power"
FROM fwd1, fwd_torque

UNION ALL

SELECT
  fwd2.time,
  'Aradex 2' AS device,
  fwd2.speed,
  fwd2.torque AS aradex_torque,
  fwd_torque.torque AS measured_torque,
  fwd2.torque_setpoint,
  fwd2.power_stage_temp,
  fwd2.igbt_temp,
  fwd2."power"
FROM fwd2, fwd_torque

ORDER BY device;

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  speed__value AS aradex1_speed
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  speed__value AS aradex1_speed
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  speed__value AS aradex2_speed
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  speed__value AS aradex2_speed
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  torque__value AS aradex1_torque
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  torque__value AS aradex1_torque
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  torque__value AS aradex2_torque
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  torque__value AS aradex2_torque
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  shear_beam_calculated__value AS measured_torque
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  shear_beam_calculated__value AS measured_torque
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  power__value AS aradex1_power
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  power__value AS aradex1_power
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  power__value AS aradex2_power
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  power__value AS aradex2_power
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp);

WITH supply AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft_supply
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft_return AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft_supply
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_return AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_fwd_supply
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  LEAST(supply.time, aft_return.time) AS time,
  supply.temperature AS supply_temp,
  aft_return.temperature AS return_temp,
  aft_return.temperature - supply.temperature AS delta_temp
FROM supply, aft_return

UNION ALL

SELECT
  LEAST(supply.time, fwd_return.time) AS time,
  supply.temperature AS supply_temp,
  fwd_return.temperature AS return_temp,
  fwd_return.temperature - supply.temperature AS delta_temp
FROM supply, fwd_return;

WITH aft AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temp_power_stage__value AS ara1_power_stage_temp,
    temp_igbt__value AS ara1_power_igbt_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temp_power_stage__value AS ara1_power_stage_temp,
    temp_igbt__value AS ara1_power_igbt_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT * FROM aft
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM fwd;

WITH aft AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temp_power_stage__value AS ara2_power_stage_temp,
    temp_igbt__value AS ara2_power_igbt_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temp_power_stage__value AS ara2_power_stage_temp,
    temp_igbt__value AS ara2_power_igbt_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT * FROM aft
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM fwd;

WITH aft AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    hydr_tank_temp__value AS oil_tank_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    hydr_tank_temp__value AS oil_tank_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT * FROM aft
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM fwd;

WITH aft_supply AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft_supply
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft_return1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft1_return
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft_return2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_aft2_return
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_supply AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_fwd_supply
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_return1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_fwd1_return
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_return2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    temperature__value AS temperature
  FROM public.marpower__500000_thrs__lt1__lt1_temperature_propdrive_fwd2_return
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  LEAST(aft_supply.time, aft_return1.time, aft_return2.time) AS time,
  aft_supply.temperature AS supply_temp,
  aft_return1.temperature AS return1_temp,
  aft_return2.temperature AS return2_temp,
  aft_return1.temperature - aft_supply.temperature AS delta1_temp,
  aft_return2.temperature - aft_supply.temperature AS delta2_temp
FROM aft_supply, aft_return1, aft_return2

UNION ALL

SELECT
  LEAST(fwd_supply.time, fwd_return1.time, fwd_return2.time) AS time,
  fwd_supply.temperature AS supply_temp,
  fwd_return1.temperature AS return1_temp,
  fwd_return2.temperature AS return2_temp,
  fwd_return1.temperature - fwd_supply.temperature AS delta1_temp,
  fwd_return2.temperature - fwd_supply.temperature AS delta2_temp
FROM fwd_supply, fwd_return1, fwd_return2;

WITH aft AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    aft_thrust_windingtempu_1__value AS winding_temp_u1,
    aft_thrust_windingtempv_1__value AS winding_temp_v1,
    aft_thrust_windingtempw_1__value AS winding_temp_w1,
    aft_thrust_windingtempu_2__value AS winding_temp_u2,
    aft_thrust_windingtempv_2__value AS winding_temp_v2,
    aft_thrust_windingtempw_2__value AS winding_temp_w2,
    stern_thrust_bearing_de_temp__value AS bearing_de_temp,
    stern_thrust_bearing_nde_temp__value AS bearing_nde_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion_general
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    fwd_thrust_windingtempu_1__value AS winding_temp_u1,
    fwd_thrust_windingtempv_1__value AS winding_temp_v1,
    fwd_thrust_winding_temp_w_1__value AS winding_temp_w1,
    bow_thrust_windingtempu_2__value AS winding_temp_u2,
    bow_thrust_windingtempv_2__value AS winding_temp_v2,
    bow_thrust_windingtempw_2__value AS winding_temp_w2,
    bow_thrust_bearing_de_temp__value AS bearing_de_temp,
    bow_thrust_bearing_nde_temp__value AS bearing_nde_temp
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion_general
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT * FROM aft
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM fwd;

WITH aft_motor AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_power_aft_trstr_kw" AS motor_power
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_motor AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    "devices__thruster_test.r_power_fwd_trstr_kw" AS motor_power
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd1 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara1
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd2 AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    power__value AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd_ara2
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  aft_motor.time                                                            AS time,
  aft_motor.motor_power                                                     AS motor_power,
  aft1.power + aft2.power                                                   AS aradex_power
FROM aft_motor, aft1, aft2

UNION ALL

SELECT
  LEAST(fwd_motor.time, fwd1.time, fwd2.time)                               AS time,
  fwd_motor.motor_power                                                     AS motor_power,
  fwd1.power + fwd2.power                                                   AS aradex_power
FROM fwd_motor, fwd1, fwd2;

WITH aft1 AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('second', timestamp) AS time,
    AVG(power__value) AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara1
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY date_trunc('second', timestamp)
),
aft2 AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('second', timestamp) AS time,
    AVG(power__value) AS "power"
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft_ara2

  aft2.speed / GREATEST(aft_motor.motor_speed, 1)                                      AS gear_ratio,

  FROM public.prop_test__data

  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

    "devices__thruster_test.r_propellor_torque" AS prop_torque
  FROM public.prop_test__data
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
aft_measured AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    shear_beam_calculated__value AS randax_torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_aft
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
fwd_measured AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    shear_beam_calculated__value AS randax_torque
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion__pcs_fwd
  WHERE '${aft_fwd}' = 'FWD' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  LEAST(aft_motor.time, aft_measured.time)                                            AS time,
  ABS(aft_motor.prop_torque)                                                           AS prop_torque,
  aft_measured.randax_torque                                                           AS randax_torque,
  (aft_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio})                                         AS ideal_prop_torque,
  (aft_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio}) - ABS(aft_motor.prop_torque)            AS thruster_loss,
  ABS(aft_motor.prop_torque) / NULLIF(aft_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio}, 0)  AS thruster_efficiency
FROM aft_motor, aft_measured

UNION ALL

  ABS(fwd_motor.prop_torque) / NULLIF(fwd_measured.randax_torque * ${gear_ratio}, 0)  AS thruster_efficiency
FROM fwd_motor, fwd_measured
